# PLAN — iteration 2

## Current state assessment

Iteration 1 is the verified best: it passed all gates with 20 LUTs, 20 FFs, WNS 0.105 ns, and WHS 0.180 ns. It used four DSP48s for the products. Since timing is feasible, iteration 2 must strictly reduce LUTs—or tie LUTs and reduce FFs—to improve the `minimize_luts` objective.

## Hypothesis

Mapping the two 17-bit pair-sum adders into DSP48 resources may reduce LUT use, at the cost of additional DSPs.

## Instruction for generator

Keep the four product operations’ existing `use_dsp = "yes"` attributes and apply the same attribute to the 17-bit `input_partial_lo` and `input_partial_hi` additions. Preserve their unsigned 17-bit widths and the two-stage handshake, reset, registered output, and latency behavior, including the top’s `// @latency 2` annotation. Retain this candidate only if it passes every gate and improves the objective against the verified incumbent; the expected DSP increase is acceptable only if LUTs decrease or LUTs tie while FFs decrease.
